Already use DegreeSteps? Open this test in a private browser window and skip the account-saving task. That keeps sample courses separate from your real plan.

Keep this tab open for your notes. Explore the website in the other tab without asking for directions. If a task takes more than two minutes without progress, mark it “Got stuck” and move on.

A little context

No name or email needed. You can leave anything blank.

1

Find a degree you would consider.

Start with what matters to you: your goals, budget, time, or college experience. If you don’t know your degree yet, explore. Tell us what you picked and why.

How did this go?
2

Bring your past courses into the plan.

Use the sample course file above instead of your own records. Add those courses, then look at how they affect your plan. If you’re starting from zero, also see whether you can continue without past courses.

How did this go?
3

Change your mind, and correct a mistake.

Try a different degree or school. See what happens to the sample courses you added. Then imagine you accidentally marked a course finished: change it back to the correct status.

How did this go?
4

Keep your plan for later.

Try saving your work, then close the DegreeSteps tab and come back to your plan. Keep this feedback tab open. If you don’t want to create an account or sign in, skip this task and tell us what you expected.

Keep using sample information. Don’t put a real transcript or private notes into the test plan.

How did this go?
5

Decide what you would do first.

Look at your plan. What would you take first, where would you take it, and what do you think you would spend? Show yourself where you would begin, but don’t buy or enroll in anything.

How did this go?

Before you go

Share the file or copied text with the person who invited you. DegreeSteps does not receive it automatically.

This clears the answers in this feedback tab. Download or copy them first if you want to keep them.

Thank you for helping us make degree planning easier. Participation is optional; you can stop at any time.
